summary: Frontend-only session on https://backend-audit-14.preview.emergentagent.com covering (1) new dynopay coin wordmark rollout, (2) landing bidirectional scroll-reveal, (3) Company Settings > Crypto conversion auto-convert bug fix. 9/9 requested scenarios executed. Logo rollout, favicon/press/email assets, scroll-reveal (bidirectional, no flicker, reduced-motion, layout integrity), dashboard/transactions regression, company-1 read-only pre-selection and the SMADAV (company 71) write test all PASS at network + DOM level. Two real defects found: the auto-convert success toast is never rendered (dialog unmounts before the toast mounts) and a React hydration mismatch console error from the Reveal wrapper on the landing page. SMADAV auto-convert was toggled on/off for the write test and is VERIFIED back to 'No' (GET /api/company/auto-convert/71 -> auto_convert_enabled:false).

ui_bugs.issue: Success toast 'Auto-convert is on — volatile coins now settle as USDT (TRC20)' NEVER appears. handleSubmit calls showToast() (which defers with setTimeout(...,0)) and then handleClose() -> provider (Components/UI/CompanySettingsDialog/context.tsx renders `{open && company && <CompanySettingsDialog/>}`) unmounts the dialog AND its <Toast>, so the deferred toast state update lands on an unmounted tree. Verified with 100ms DOM polling for 9s after Save: only the generic 'Company updated successfully' toast appears. Error toasts still work (they `return` before handleClose).

React hydration mismatch console error on landing page: 'Prop `style` did not match. Server: height:100%;opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px) Client: height:100%;opacity:1;transform:none'. Dev-only warning, but it also means the SSR HTML ships every below-hero section at opacity 0 (invisible without JS / to non-JS crawlers). Suggest rendering initial=false on SSR (mounted flag) or keeping SSR markup visible.

Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce all 71 wrappers keep data-reveal='out' although the inner motion div is opacity 1 / transform none (content IS visible, acceptance met). The attribute contradicts `show = reduced || inView`, so the test hook is misleading; expected data-reveal='in'.

Testability gap: the per-brand pencil (the only entry point to Company Settings from the header switcher) has no data-testid and is not exposed as a button/aria-label, so it had to be clicked by computed coordinates. The Crypto conversion accordion header and the auto_convert_volatile_crypto / convert_to_stablecoin radios also have no data-testid.

issues: Disabled 'Save Changes' label is light grey on a light grey pill (very low contrast, looks like a rendering glitch rather than a disabled control)

action_items: Fix the missing auto-convert success toast: raise the toast from a provider-level/global toaster (or delay handleClose until after the toast is shown) — dialog + Toast are unmounted by CompanySettingsDialogProvider on close.
Fix the Reveal SSR/hydration mismatch (server renders opacity:0 for all landing sections) — gate the initial hidden state on a mounted flag so SSR HTML stays visible.
Set data-reveal='in' when prefers-reduced-motion is active (attribute currently stays 'out' while content is visible).
Add data-testid to the brand-row 'edit brand' pencil in the company switcher and to the Crypto conversion accordion + its radios.
critical_code_review_comments: Components/UI/CompanySettingsDialog/index.tsx: showToast() -> setTimeout(...,0) followed by synchronous handleClose() is unsafe because the provider only mounts the dialog while open; success feedback is guaranteed to be dropped.
Reveal.tsx: initial={{opacity:0,y}} is applied during SSR, so all below-hero content is hidden in the server HTML — bad for no-JS/crawlers and the source of the hydration warning.
Components/UI/CompanySettingsDialog/index.tsx is 759 lines — consider splitting the auto-convert save logic into a hook.

rca_of_the_issue: Missing success toast: CompanySettingsDialogProvider renders the dialog only while `open` is true. handleSubmit schedules the toast via setTimeout(...,0) and then immediately calls handleClose() -> onClose() -> setOpen(false), unmounting CompanySettingsDialog and the <Toast> it owns before the deferred setOpenToast(true) can render. Reproduce: header company switcher -> brand pencil -> Crypto conversion -> Yes + USDT (TRC20) -> Save; the PUT succeeds (200, auto_convert_enabled:true) but only the generic 'Company updated successfully' toast is seen. Mitigation: move the toast to a provider/global toaster, or await a short display before closing.
